rules.description: The orchestration the record belongs to is exactly the parent scope the seam derived into its binding.

The actor is an accepted participation (a party outside the host System) or a delegation (a subagent of the coordinating thread); a record with neither has no actor. (That the participation is accepted and unexited, or the delegation a live subagent of this orchestration's thread, is the composing application's obligation, proven by its driven gate.)
